lead: `nvs_runtime::capability` has two path resolvers that answer different spellings of one file — on Windows a `\\?\C:\…` against a plain `C:\…`.
body: `capability::canonicalize` goes through `nvs_config::capability::resolved`, which pins a not-yet-existing path's deepest existing ancestor for `Core\IO::within`, while `std::fs::canonicalize` returns the verbatim form. A door that resolves goes through `nvs_config::capability::resolved` and asks any other question, existence included, separately.
